dataset: AICO Day 2 hybrid retrieval evaluation set
matching_rule: A retrieved chunk matches an anchor when the normalised anchor string is a substring of the normalised chunk text. Normalisation: lowercase, replace every character that is not a letter, digit or space with a space, then collapse runs of whitespace to a single space and strip.
note: Q01 to Q10 are carried over unchanged from the Day 1 set so the two days are directly comparable. Q11 to Q16 are new and are written so that no significant query term appears in the target text.

scoring.hit_at_1: Rank 1 chunk matches at least one anchor.
scoring.hit_at_5: At least one chunk in ranks 1 to 5 matches at least one anchor.
scoring.mrr: 1 divided by the rank of the first matching chunk, 0 if no match in the top 5, averaged over the thirteen scored queries.
scoring.multi_chunk_full_hit: All anchors for the query are matched by at least one chunk in the top 5.
scoring.no_match: Scored separately and inverted. Correct behaviour is returning no result above the documented score floor for that mode.
